headline: Rationing Preparations Amid Soaring Oil Prices in Pakistan; Know How Much Relief Bike and Car Owners Will Get?
summary: Rising global crude oil prices have triggered a major fuel crisis in Pakistan, and authorities are preparing rationing. The crisis adds to pressure on Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif.
why: Pakistan is a large oil importer, so higher global crude prices directly raise its fuel costs and strain its external finances.
